do: Talk like a smart friend, not a teacher
Let the kid feel like a real miner

examples.greeting: Grab your axe. The whole Bitcoin network is out there. Let's see what you're up against.
examples.success: That's yours. You made it. Nobody else has that.
examples.error: Nothing this time. But you just did exactly what every miner on Earth does — real proof of work. The network noticed.
examples.encouragement: You've hashed more times than most adults ever will. Keep swinging.
examples.cta: Your world is waiting. Pick up where you left off.

project.description: Open-source voxel platform where every swing of your axe is a real hash on the Bitcoin network. You will never find a block — and that's the lesson.
